message.content:
I don’t have direct access to your system’s clock, but you can easily see the current time from the Windows Command Prompt:

1. Press **Win + R**, type `cmd`, and hit **Enter** to open a Command Prompt window.
2. In the prompt, type:
   ```
   time /t
   ```
   and press **Enter**.

This will display the current local time (e.g., `10:45 AM`). If you need the full date and time, you can use:
```
date /t & time /t
```
which will show both the date and the time.
